zh-CN.name: 液态玻璃
zh-CN.description: Apple 提出的动态界面材质，结合透明、光学变化和流动感，用于建立控件与内容的层级。网页中的模糊透明卡片只是近似视觉，不能默认声称等同于平台原生材质。
use_when: 目标平台确实支持相应原生材质与组件。
需要表达轻量悬浮控件与内容之间的层级。
avoid_when: 网页近似不能宣称已经还原原生光学行为。
密集内容与变化背景下必须检查可读性。
zh-CN.prompt_template: 先确认目标平台与可用材质；支持原生能力时采用对应平台组件，网页方案明确标注视觉近似；限定透明材质的使用范围，保证文字、状态和操作边界可辨，提供减少透明与动态效果的替代。

en.name: Liquid Glass
en.description: Apple’s dynamic interface material combining transparency, optical behavior and fluidity to establish hierarchy between controls and content. A blurred translucent web card is only an approximation, not automatically the native platform material.
use_when: The target platform supports the relevant native materials and components.
The design needs a lightweight hierarchy between controls and content.
avoid_when: Do not claim native optical behavior for a web approximation.
Check legibility over busy content and changing backgrounds.
en.prompt_template: Confirm the target platform and available material first. Use the corresponding platform components where supported and label web treatments as visual approximations. Limit translucent surfaces, preserve readable text and state boundaries, and provide reduced-transparency and reduced-motion alternatives.
